core_obligations: Unramified at each x_i implies locally of finite type near them (Morphisms, Definition unramified); replace X by an open neighbourhood.
More on Morphisms, Lemma etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-multiple-points-var supplies the etale neighbourhood (U, u) and opens V_ij finite over U.
Lemma finite-unramified-one-point shrinks U so that each V_ij -> U is a closed immersion.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to locally of finite type by definition of unramified; apply the More on Morphisms lemma for the etale neighbourhood and the V_ij; apply the finite-unramified one-point lemma (this chapter) to shrink U to a closed-immersion situation.
difficulty_reason: Three-stage reduction: locality of finite type, a cross-chapter quasi-finite lemma producing the etale neighbourhood and finite-over-U opens, then an in-chapter shrink to closed immersions.
